name: flux-messenger
description: Flux Messenger - Real-time messaging with WebRTC (full-stack single service)

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
